blocks.text: I am opening this thread so that our notes on the {{fact:f:E-2008-001.client}} redesign stay in one place as the work moves. For the file, the working contacts are set: on our side I am carrying the engagement day to day, so anything touching scope, pace, or a decision that needs making comes to me, Jason Torres, with Brenda Rodriguez leading the analysis and issuing the data requests; on the client side I have logged Linda Gallegos as our point of contact. A first, deliberately narrow request will reach you from Brenda this week.

We have made a start on the baseline. Brenda Rodriguez has begun tracing the core processes from the materials your team sent over, and the early read is the familiar one, that the flow is tidier on paper than the people doing the work describe it to be. To move on to the cost picture we need two things from your side: read access to the last two years of the cost data behind the operating budget, and thirty minutes each with the two managers your note flagged as the ones who really run the process.

If the data access needs a sign-off on your side, tell me who I should ask and I will approach them directly rather than put it back on your desk. Otherwise Brenda will send the specific list tomorrow, and we will keep this thread as the single place these requests and their answers live.
